info.title: FinOps Enterprise API
info.description: Expenses, approvals, budgets, reports and notifications. Every `/api` call needs a caller: the token identifies them, and their roles, permissions and department memberships come from the application's database. Writes to an expense need `If-Match` with the ETag from the last read.

get.summary: Current provisioned application profile and effective access.
Lists only departments authorized by application-owned membership and permissions.
Newest-first audit trail of workflow actions and denied attempts.
Lists expenses visible to the caller: their own, their departments' (managers), or all (finance/admin).

post.summary: Creates a draft expense in a department the caller is an active member of.

get.summary: Expense detail with approval history, the caller's allowed actions, and an ETag for updates.

put.summary: Edits a draft. Requires If-Match with the ETag from the last read.

get.summary: Monthly budgets for a year (default: current), limited to the departments you may see.

post.summary: Sets a department's budget for a month (one per department and month; 409 if it exists).

put.summary: Changes a budget amount. Requires If-Match.

get.summary: Budget vs. posted, committed (approved) and pending (submitted) spend per department and month. Runs finance.usp_BudgetVsActual with a server-resolved department scope.
Reports you may run, with their parameters and formats.
Runs a report. format=json (default, preview), pdf or xlsx. Dates are yyyy-MM-dd.
The caller's newest 50 notifications and their unread count.

post.summary: Marks one of the caller's notifications as read. Idempotent; someone else's is a 404.

get.summary: Pending and dead-lettered message counts, and the newest dead letters (no payloads).

post.summary: Returns a dead-lettered message to the queue with the same ID, so handlers that already committed are not repeated. Audited.

EntraBearer.description: A Microsoft Entra access token for this API with the `FinOps.Access` scope.
